summary: The job did exactly what was asked and gets main's history check passing again. But it does that by adding a fifth hand-written exemption to an integrity check, with no new decision record and no owner approval on file. It does nothing about why squash merges keep breaking the check. So it fixes the symptom while the brief asks for root causes ("favor fixing root causes", R3), and it weakens a check without the warden or owner sign-off the 2026-10-16 addendum calls for.

findings.text: The requested change is in place and matches the earlier exemptions. The full SHA is appended to [history] exempt, with a comment naming PR #130 and both jobs.

The same failure keeps coming back: squash merges that carry several jobs, or no job, break the landing and chain checks. This makes four squash exemptions. The job adds a fifth exempt entry and changes nothing in the cause (squash merges, or the check's handling of multi-job squashes), which goes against the 'favor fixing root causes' addendum and Olympus R3 and §5.1.
findings.evidence: outcome/athena.toml:140-151 lists ee4b0dd (PR #8 squash), f2a8453 (PR #9 squash), 5a73478 (PR #14 squash) and now 39962ed (PR #130 squash). CHANGELOG.md:66 says "The chain-landing check itself is unchanged."

findings.text: The exemption says a job whose own PR was closed unmerged (#129) still had its landing carried onto main. Instead of checking whether that work was verified and accepted, the exemption silences the check that flagged it. This puts at risk 'Nothing reaches the main branch ... without passing verification' (A5) and 'Every commit on main traces to accepted work'.
findings.evidence: outcome/athena.toml:147-149: "20261010-154004-60r4 (its PR #129 was closed unmerged) ... the history check finds that neither landing is valid in that commit."

findings.text: Adding an exemption weakens a check. The 2026-10-16 addendum says the warden holds any landing that weakens a check, and only the owner changes their rules. Unlike ee4b0dd, which cites 'the user's choice of option (a) in D66', the new entry cites no decision and no owner approval. The job changed only athena.toml and CHANGELOG.md, so it added no decision record.
findings.evidence: outcome/athena.toml:141 says "Excused by the user's choice of option (a) in D66". The new entry at :147-151 cites no D-number of its own, and OUTCOME.md lists only CHANGELOG.md and athena.toml as changed.

findings.text: The comment at the top of the section is now false for most entries. It says the exempt commits 'predate Athena', but the 39962ed, ee4b0dd and 5a73478 entries are squashes of Athena's own PRs. Its own comments contradict it, and a stranger reading it would be misled.
findings.evidence: outcome/athena.toml:136 says "Commits that predate Athena and are exempt...", while :147 says "39962ed... is the squash of PR #130".

findings.text: The changelog says main's check 'passes again'. That cannot be confirmed from the files I was given (no CI run or command output). I am treating it as a claim, not as observed.
findings.evidence: outcome/CHANGELOG.md:62 says "Main's \"full history\" check passes again."
